subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): update ssrf-runtime import path in cdp-proxy-bypass

question: Should the Browser/Ollama package-subpath regression be fixed by preserving owner-scoped private access, or by deliberately promoting these SSRF/proxy helpers into the public Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: Current source, docs, tests, and scoped AGENTS.md treat this as a private bundled-plugin helper, but the PR proposes a public SDK expansion with security-boundary implications.

options.title: Preserve Private Owner-Scoped Access
options.body: Fix the packaged Browser/Ollama lazy-load path through the existing private bundled-plugin alias/export mechanism or another narrow private seam.

options.title: Promote Public SDK Surface
options.body: Land a deliberate SDK expansion with docs, contract/baseline updates, and package smoke proof showing Browser/Ollama lazy-loading works after the change.

options.title: Pause For Canonical PR
options.body: Hold this branch until maintainers choose one sibling candidate PR as the canonical repair for the linked regression.

recommendation.title: Preserve Private Owner-Scoped Access
recommendation.body: Fix the packaged Browser/Ollama lazy-load path through the existing private bundled-plugin alias/export mechanism or another narrow private seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is an SDK/package-boundary policy decision, and this person authored the relevant private SDK declaration hardening.
